description: Sell curve shares back to a launchpad bonding curve for COOK (unwrapped to native COOK by default). Only works while the pool is live and only for shares bought via launchpad_buy — a graduated token's SPL balance is sold with `trade` instead. A 1% trade fee applies. PAIRED launches: sells REAL tokens from your wallet (`shares` = the token amount); the holder tax comes off them on the way into the pool, and the sell carries an on-chain minimum (`slippageBps`, default 1%). Simulates before sending. Requires COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY.

ref.description: the token mint or the launchpad pool address (either works)

shares.description: how many tokens (curve shares) to sell, as a UI amount

slippageBps.description: PAIRED launches only: slippage tolerance in bps for the on-chain minimum (default 100 = 1%)

unwrap.description: unwrap the proceeds to native COOK (default true)

name: launchpad_sell
title: Sell on a launchpad curve
